question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

Henry ___________ objections to the proposed changes in company policy.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (raised)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"raised"** means to bring up, express, or mention something, often in the context of a concern or objection. (उठाया)

 
 
• **Example:** She raised concerns about the safety measures in the new construction plan.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, "Henry raised objections" is the correct collocation, as it conveys the act of expressing concerns or opposition to the proposed changes in company policy. (आपत्ति जताना)
 
 
• **Example:** Henry raised objections to the proposed changes in company policy during the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (raised)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spelt** (हिज्जे बताया): Past tense of "spell," often used in the context of writing or pronouncing words correctly.

 
 
• **Example:** He spelt his name carefully on the form.
 
 
 
• **Stood** (खड़ा हुआ): Past tense of "stand," meaning to be in an upright position or to take a stance.
 
 
• **Example:** He stood at the entrance waiting for his friends.
 
 
 
• **Spread** (फैलाना): To distribute or extend over a surface or area.
 
 
• **Example:** The news spread quickly across the town.
